runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-library> --game <set> --rom-path <authorized-rom-root> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --scenario <committed-scenario> --boot-wait <seconds> --output <external-run.json>. The retained German repeat used --boot-wait 0; the older traces do not record the boot-wait argument. Initialization and NVRAM provenance are recorded per run.

coil-test.limitation: A transition is ROM activity under the recorded conditions; it does not establish a fitted load, polarity, or physical identity.
coil-test.note: Coil Test: 30 steps matched across two cycles. Step: public solenoid address = displayed label: 1:1 = OUTHOLE; 2:25 = FLSH-BALL LOCK; 3:2 = TROUGH; 4:26 = FLSH-LEFT RAMP; 5:3 = NOT USED; 6:27 = FLSH-LEFT FLIP; 7:4 = TOP DT BANK; 8:28 = FLSH-I. TOP LEFT; 9:5 = KNOCKER; 10:29 = FLSH-I. TOP SPIN; 11:6 = BOTTOM DT BANK; 12:30 = FLSH-I. DROP HOLE; 13:7 = BALL DIVERTOR; 14:31 = FLSH-I. TOP RIGHT; 15:8 = BALL LOCKER; 16:32 = FLSH-I. BALL GATE; 17:9 = FLSH-DT BANK; 18:10 = PLAYFIELD G.I.; 19:11 = BACKBOX G.I.; 20:12 = A/C SELECT; 21:13 = RIGHT BALL GATE; 22:14 = LEF. OUTLN KICKER; 23:15 = NOT USED; 24:16 = FLSH-VERT RAMP; 25:17 = LEFT JET; 26:18 = LEFT SLING; 27:19 = RIGHT JET; 28:20 = RIGHT SLING; 29:21 = BOTTOM JET; 30:22 = TOP JET. Relay 12 rises ahead of C-side pulses and is included as a step only when its own A/C SELECT label is displayed. Decoded from raw segments: 1 is 0x0006 and bit 15 is a period; 0/O and 5/S share glyphs and are shown as O and S. Outer display padding is trimmed; the frame-reading seed retains the full decoded rows and their segment digests. Compared with radcl_l1: 0 differing ordered readings.

nvram-init.note: Retained initialization run. The controlled-driver byte 9-16 rises together then clears at power-up; output15 is part of this whole-byte transient, not proof of a fitted top sling. First rise/clear host times are 0.216301/0.26591 seconds. ROM archive members checked against src/wpc/s11games.c SHA-1: rad_u26.l1 dd01fb9189acd2620c57149921aadb051f7a2412; rad_u27.l1 a61055aab97d3fe2ecd0ed4281a9681b1d910269; rad_u4.l1 27984bbc91dc7593e6a5b42f74dd6ddf58189bec; rad_u19.l1 bdeea7517f2adf72b4b642bffb25ba5b98453127; rad_u20.l1 7da0289cf0a0c93768c0706fdedfc3a5f2101e77.

source.manifest_algorithm: SHA-256 of exact manifest.json bytes. tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py builds compact UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and one LF, listing every file recursively by case-sensitive POSIX relative path, size and SHA-256, excluding manifest.json and manifest.sha256.
